attentionCount: {count, plural, =1 {1 needs attention} other {# need attention}}

credentials.description: Slots the definition declares. A binding names an account, never a secret.
credentials.emptyBody: This Bot reaches nothing outside Cognia, so it asks for no credentials.
credentials.orphanBody: Credential slots are read from the definition, and this one has none to read.
credentials.title: Credentials

description: Installed Bots: what wakes each one up, what runs it, and what it is allowed to do.

detail.noSelectionBody: Pick a Bot from the list to see its triggers, credentials and policy.

listPane.emptyBody: Bots arrive with the plugins that declare them. Install a plugin that contributes one to get started.
listPane.emptyFiltered: No Bot matches this search and filter.
listPane.label: Bot list

orphan.body: The plugin that defines this Bot is disabled or uninstalled, so there is nothing left to run. The installation is kept so you can see it and remove it. Re-enabling the plugin restores it exactly as it was.
orphan.title: This Bot has no definition

policy.description: The strictest ceiling every layer agreed on. A lower layer can only narrow.
policy.orphanBody: A ceiling is folded from the definition and the installation together, and there is no definition left to fold.
policy.refusal: {layer} asked to widen {field} and was overruled.
policy.refusalsHint: A layer can only narrow. These asked for more than the layer above allowed.
policy.title: Policy ceiling
policy.unconstrainedBody: No layer set a limit, so this Bot runs under the same defaults as any other run.

definition_missing.body: Nothing defines this Bot on this device any more.
definition_missing.title: Definition missing

handler_missing.body: This Bot runs a plugin handler, and the module never resolved. It cannot run until the plugin is reinstalled or fixed.
handler_missing.title: Handler did not load

version_drift.body: This installation pinned {pinned} and the plugin now ships {available}. The Bot keeps running on the version that exists, so nothing has stopped.
version_drift.title: Running a different version

row.deadLetters: {count, plural, =1 {1 dead letter} other {# dead letters}}

none.body: This browser has no long-lived runtime and no paired Host, so nothing will pick up a Bot's work. Pair a Host or use the desktop app to make these Bots run.
none.title: Nothing is running these Bots

paired.body: The Host you are paired with runs these Bots. This device reads their state and relays changes to it.
paired.title: A paired Host runs these Bots

remote.body: This window is driving a remote Host, and that Host runs its own Bots. Nothing is executed here while the remote connection is active.
remote.title: The remote Host runs these Bots

title: Bots

triggers.description: What wakes this Bot up. A trigger that is off stays listed, so an absent schedule and a switched-off one never look alike.
triggers.emptyBody: This Bot declares no triggers, so only a manual run can start it.
triggers.orphanBody: Triggers are read from the definition, and this one has none to read.
triggers.title: Triggers
